# Comprehensive Pre-Implementation Quality Checklist: Core Space Shooter Engine

**Purpose**: Formal requirements-quality and architectural gate for Tech Leads and Reviewers to validate specification rigor, quantitative bounds, and Constitution alignment before approving task decomposition and implementation.  
**Created**: 2026-11-04  
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.  
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.  
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does NOT mean implementation work is complete. All newly generated items begin unchecked (`[ ]`).

---

## 1. Flight Dynamics & Weapon Control Quality

- [ ] CHK001 Are the 8 movement directions and coordinate clamping boundaries explicitly quantified for viewport containment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the diagonal speed normalization factor ($1/\sqrt{2} \approx 0.7071$) specified with mathematical precision to prevent diagonal traversal advantages? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the primary weapon fire-rate cooldown intervals (seconds between shots) explicitly quantified for each weapon tier? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the weapon downgrade / tier reset behavior upon losing a life consistently specified across user stories, edge cases, and functional requirements? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the behavior of surplus weapon power-up pickups at Tier 3 (1,000 bonus score award) quantified without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, User Story 4]

## 2. Hitbox Precision, Collision & Grazing Standards

- [ ] CHK006 Are the geometric shape and dimension ratio of the player ship core hitbox explicitly quantified as 40–50% centered at the cockpit? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, DataModel §HitboxComponent]
- [ ] CHK007 Does the specification clearly define that wingtip grazing outside the 40–50% core hitbox produces zero health deduction? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK008 Are projectile collision radii and enemy collision boundaries defined with specific measurable bounds? [Completeness, DataModel §HitboxComponent]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the spatial partitioning grid cell dimension ($64 \times 64$ pixels) specified to ensure $O(N)$ broadphase collision efficiency under peak entity density? [Measurability, Plan §Constitution Check, Research §3]

## 3. Enemy Wave Choreography & Tactical Behaviors

- [ ] CHK010 Are enemy squad entry flight trajectories specified using multi-point cubic Bézier splines with defined off-screen entry margins? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the squad entry batch sizes (4–6 units) and inter-squad spawn timings quantified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK012 Are health points, point values, attack dive patterns, and drop tables distinctly quantified for all 3 enemy archetypes (Scout, Fighter, Commander)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, DataModel §EnemyBehaviorComponent]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the difficulty scaling progression (+10% speed/frequency modifiers per cleared wave) mathematically bounded for endless play? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-013]

## 4. Vitality, Lives System & State Lifecycle

- [ ] CHK014 Are the starting life stock (3 lives) and health points per life explicitly quantified on the HUD model? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the post-damage invulnerability duration (0.5s) and post-respawn invulnerability duration (2.5s) specified with exact timeframes? [Measurability, Spec §FR-004, §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the safe respawn coordinate (bottom-center) and damage immunity window bounded to prevent instant spawn-camping deaths? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, DataModel §GameState]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the exact state transition triggers and invariants defined for all FSM states (`BOOT`, `TITLE`, `WAVE_INTRO`, `PLAYING`, `PAUSED`, `RESPAWNING`, `GAME_OVER`)? [Completeness, DataModel §2, Plan §Summary]

## 5. Constitution & Performance Invariants (Frame-Budget & Object Pooling)

- [ ] CHK018 Are strict pre-warmed pool capacities explicitly quantified for all high-frequency entities (`PlayerBullet: 50`, `EnemyBullet: 150`, `Enemy: 60`, `Particle: 300`, `PowerUp: 20`)? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK019 Is the exhaustion policy (e.g., ring buffer recycling vs drop) defined for every individual pool to prevent gameplay stalling or crashes? [Completeness, Constitution §IV, DataModel §3]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the zero-allocation rule (`new`, heap allocations, array growth forbidden in the 60 FPS update/render loops) documented as a mandatory review gate? [Consistency, Constitution §II, §IV, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the peak load benchmark explicitly quantified (40 enemies, 150 bullets, 300 particles sustaining $\le 16.7$ ms frame budget)? [Measurability, Constitution §II, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is native Retina / high-DPI canvas resolution scaling (`window.devicePixelRatio`) specified to eliminate blurry upscaling? [Clarity, Constitution §I, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK023 Does the plan enforce component composition with inheritance depth restricted to $\le 2$ levels? [Consistency, Constitution §III, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK024 Are IP safety and original asset requirements enforced to forbid use of Bandai Namco's "Galaga" trademark or copyrighted sprites/audio? [Consistency, Constitution §V, Research §1]

## 6. Visual Juice & Accessibility Controls

- [ ] CHK025 Are visual feedback triggers (1-frame white hit-flash, directional particle spark/debris bursts, additive laser bloom) defined for each combat event? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the micro screen-shake duration strictly bounded to $<0.2$ seconds? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK027 Does the specification mandate user settings to reduce or disable screen shake and flashing effects for visual comfort and accessibility? [Completeness, Spec §FR-016, Constitution §I]

## 7. Data Persistence & Company Leaderboard Contracts

- [ ] CHK028 Are the exact storage keys and schema for client-side `localStorage` high-score and settings persistence defined? [Completeness, Plan §Storage, DataModel §GameState]
- [ ] CHK029 Does the score submission contract include anti-cheat validation metadata (`sessionToken`, `durationSeconds`, `highestWave`, `enemiesDefeated`)? [Completeness, Contract §leaderboard-api.yaml, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK030 Are error response codes and anti-cheat rejection behaviors (e.g. impossible score rate detection) formally specified in the OpenAPI contract? [Completeness, Contract §leaderboard-api.yaml]

---

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after the Tech Lead or Reviewer confirms the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied in the specification and planning artifacts.
- Leave items unchecked `[ ]` when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a quality gate and must not modify markers.
- Add comments or findings inline as needed during review sessions.
- All items are numbered sequentially (`CHK001`–`CHK030`) for traceability in PR reviews.
